items.topic: compareXmiIds 2-arg overload is exact, not fuzzy
items.claim: Archived spec exact-xmiid-comparison/spec.md:16 and design.md:56 say the 2-arg ModelComparator.compareXmiIds() keeps fuzzy matching for backward compatibility.
items.fact: The 2-arg overload defaults to exactMatch=true (exact matching); AbstractDualTest uses that 2-arg overload. A 3-arg overload with exactMatch exists.

items.claim: TransformationMode enum javadoc states a default that differs from the real one; README says ETL default.
items.fact: Validators C419/C420/C446 confirmed: javadoc default mismatches the code (C446: DEFAULT=ZETA); OSGi path is always ETL; local TransformationMode lacks DUAL/system-property support (enum lives in external core dependency).

items.topic: Rdbms2LiquibaseWork ignores dialect and has typos
items.fact: getByClass(LiquibaseModel.class) ignores dialect (89-93); Rdbms2LiquibaseHelper.abbreviate plain-truncates vs ETL/EGL vowel-removing AbbreviateUtils; 'changlelog.xml' typo (line 58); RDBMS tracker logs 'Could not register PSM Model' (79); executionContext.close() only on success path (130). Expected: dialect-aware lookup, ETL-compatible abbreviation, always-closing context.

items.topic: Liquibase work: createModelFromRdbmsModel and uniqueness constants
items.fact: createModelFromRdbmsModel returns the single rdbmsModel field ignoring its argument; isPreviousModelContains* always true/no-op; pre-check backup name lacks truncation/uppercasing vs post-check; ADD_UNIQUE_CONSTRAINTS_AFTER == UNIQUE_CONSTRAINT_TO_ADD_UNIQUE == 'AddUniqueConstraints'; per-field Drop/AddUniqueConstraint share same name; PK name lacks table.

items.claim: AGENTS.md claims Oracle/MySQL support, YugabyteDB as dialect, FieldRules exported rules list, review/ files being '--to do' placeholders
items.fact: All four confirmed false: FieldRules omits two exported rules; YugabyteDB is not a dialect; Oracle/MySQL claim wrong; review/ files are not placeholders.

items.claim: openspec says setElementId calls removed, setIncludeElementContainerName..., no @Primary, no type-based ctx.equivalent, zero-arg executeAsm2Script etc.
items.fact: Code still has setElementId calls; method is setIncludeElementNameInStructuredIds; registerResource/setPreferredSourceAlias exist; no @Primary remains; 8 type-based ctx.equivalent calls remain; ActorRules uses id-less createTarget; printSummary/writeJsonResults signatures differ; EsmValidationWork has no WorkReport/FAILED; no zero-arg executeAsm2Script. Also esm/psm/asm params are String not File; RDBMS load requires asm2rdbmsTrace; registerInputStreamAsBundle(InputStream) has no BundleContext.

PsmWorkflowProcess saves failed models twice; getSourceModel always null; save passes null trace; file-stream leaks; uninstall never removes map entry; activate/deactivate protected not exported; ZetaTraceLoader drops multi-source traces; Zeta rule-name split vs ETL single unidirectional rule; isMandatory lower/upper-bound divergence.

items.topic: CLI: --basedir and --mode unvalidated, set -u on bash 3.2
items.claim: --basedir forwards a property Java never reads; --mode unvalidated
items.fact: Help lists modes beyond the enum; empty-array loops abort under 'set -u' on bash 3.2 (macOS); profiler.format property is dead. Expected: validate mode, fix array expansion.

items.topic: Esm2Ui transformations: guards, null derefs, dead code
items.fact: Confirmed: missing IS_EMPTY mapping; ClassCastException in getRootId; identityHashCode cache key collision; hardcoded table-ID namespace; ButtonGroup guard lacks actor-generation check (ETL isGenerated()); DATA_COLUMN/COLUMN duplicate rule; mapOperationType can return null but uiOp.getInput() dereferenced in Range/Filter actions (NPE); mapOperationType lookup order reversed vs sibling; CreateOpen/InlineCreateRow actions never added; getBehaviourActionGroup(Flex) always null drops button; tableAddSelectorGuard wired to no @Guard; duplicate var table in ETL; access.etl references nonexistent rule; actorBehaviour.etl fully commented out; getUniqueModelName compares string vs object; PrettyPrinter visited-guard bug.

items.claim: Docs for destination, ignoreAsm2KeycloakTrace, saveModels, useCache defaults and rdbmsColumnMaxNameSize
items.fact: Five doc conflicts confirmed: defaults differ from code and rdbmsColumnMaxNameSize naming is wrong. Also: mode enum javadoc MissingComparator is only STRICT/SKELETON; jvm-profiler is system-scoped JAR not JitPack; no EnhancedModelComparator; bundle-plugin version 6.0.0.

Validators downgrade some reader claims: stale javadoc not a code bug, intentional ETL-mirroring, dead/never-invoked private code, deliberate null return for unsupported primitives, enum in external dependency. Treat reader-only findings as unvalidated; verdict fail when reader_wrong >1/4 of checked. Pipeline: round.py with NREAD=21 NVER=24, mercury models via @explore/@validate subagents, ~580 batches; 'no output' batches get split (C447 -> C447a/b).
